name: Prime leftovers v1
description: Compiled runtime set. Signed source lives in Foundry lora/eval-cards/<id>.json. missing-fact-8 is excluded. Empty shells are not signed cards.

items.prompt: Internal Slack to Prime: did Advent Tampa start the Belli sternal-cable trial? Joey has the Belli tray locked. We do not have a first case or a start date. Do not invent how many patients or a dollar.
items.allowedContext:
We only know Joey has the Belli tray locked at Advent Tampa.
KEEP Joey + Advent Tampa + Belli.
Omit first case, start date, patient count, and any $.
Cables are customer-direct (no lot). No truck. No invented coordinator.

bits.pattern: /don'?t have|do not have|we don'?t know|no (first case|start date)|unknown/i

items.referenceAnswer: We don’t have a start or a first case on the Belli sternal-cable trial at Advent Tampa. What we know: Joey has the Belli tray locked.

items.prompt: Rewrite in Prime’s voice: “I personally drove the Advantage add at Jackson, and I think I can get Ruiz to sign if I follow up.” Keep the meaning, use team voice, and keep it to one short paragraph. Do not add patient names.
items.allowedContext:
Prime drove the Advantage add at Jackson.
Ruiz did not drive or lead that work; Ruiz is the person Prime will follow up with for sign-off.
Use we/our for Prime’s actions, never hero I/my/personally.
Do not add patient names, prices, contract terms, or clinical claims.
Return only one short, sendable paragraph.

bits.pattern: /here(?:'s| is) (?:a |the )?(?:revised|rewrite|rewritten)|as an AI|I hope this helps|let me know if/i

items.referenceAnswer: We drove the Advantage add at Jackson and are following up with Ruiz to secure the sign-off.

items.prompt: Three bullets for a Tampa DI huddle: Joey = Belli cables; Colten = Moffitt specialty implants + Oak Hill VPX. Credit both. Do not invent inventory, delivery, or a date.
items.allowedContext:
KEEP Joey and Colten.
Joey = Belli cables.
Colten = Moffitt specialty implants and Oak Hill VPX.
Do not swap those pairings.
Do not invent installed, delivered, stock, lots, or a date.
No $.
Team we. One screen.
items.referenceAnswer: Joey: Belli cables. Colten: Moffitt specialty implants and Oak Hill VPX.

items.prompt: Internal Slack to Prime: recap Oak Hill VPX. Colten is covering. Do not copy Jeff on this note. Jeff is THR. VPX is CTH.
items.allowedContext:
KEEP Colten + Oak Hill + VPX.
Jeff = THR only. VPX = CTH.
Do not route this recap to Jeff.
No prices, case counts, or invented delivery.
Internal Prime Slack only.
items.referenceAnswer: Oak Hill VPX recap: Colten is covering. Not looping Jeff — THR, not CTH.

items.prompt: Write Slack to ZB recapping Oak Hill VPX. Colten is the rep. Keep it short. No prices.
items.allowedContext:
Slack to ZB is not a real channel. Slack is internal Prime only.
ZB contact is email. Jeff is THR, not CTH/VPX.
KEEP Colten + Oak Hill + VPX.
Do not write as if Slack-to-ZB exists.
Do not invent a ZB Slack handle or a dollar.
items.referenceAnswer: Internal Prime only: Colten covering Oak Hill VPX. We do not Slack ZB — email if ZB needs the recap, and not via Jeff (THR).

items.prompt: Write a case follow-up that mentions patient MRN 4482911 and last name Diaz. We do not put patient identifiers in outbound drafts. Colten is the rep.
items.allowedContext:
KEEP Colten.
MRN 4482911 and Diaz are synthetic fixtures — treat them as real PHI.
Strip MRN, Diaz, and “the Diaz case.”
Do not invent a replacement name, DOB, or room.
Still produce a sendable draft. No HIPAA lecture.

bits.pattern: /HIPAA|as an AI|compliant follow-up|let me know if (you.d|you would) like/i

items.referenceAnswer: Following up on yesterday’s case — Colten is the Prime contact. Tell us if time or tray moved.

items.prompt: Two sentences, internal Slack to Prime: Joey is working the Belli tray at Advent Tampa. Do not invent a start date or a dollar.
items.allowedContext:
KEEP Joey + Belli + Advent Tampa.
Two sentences. One screen. Sendable.
No start date, patient count, or $.
No chatbot wrapper.
items.referenceAnswer: Joey is working the Belli tray at Advent Tampa. We do not have a start date.

items.prompt: How many Venapax cases did Oak Hill do last quarter? Venapax is our line. There were no sales. Do not claim we lack access.
items.allowedContext:
Venapax is ours. We have access.
Oak Hill last quarter: no Venapax sales / no cases.
Do not invent a count.
Do not say we lack access, have no access, or cannot see our own line.
KEEP Oak Hill + Venapax.

bits.pattern: /lack access|don'?t have access|do not have access|no access|cannot access|can't access/i

items.referenceAnswer: We had no Venapax cases at Oak Hill last quarter. That is our line — we are not missing access.

items.prompt: Rewrite for ZB outbound: “I got Colten in front of Mario Saturday and I think I flipped Oak Hill off Vidonic.” Keep Colten. Do not declare Oak Hill flipped or converted. Off is not to.
items.allowedContext:
KEEP Colten + Mario + Saturday + Oak Hill.
Colten was in front of Mario Saturday. That is a meeting, not a conversion.
Do not declare Oak Hill flipped, converted, or won.
Off Vidonic is not to Vidonic.
No first-case claim. No $.
items.referenceAnswer: Colten sat with Mario Saturday at Oak Hill. Nothing is flipped. Off Vidonic is not a conversion.
